Hi Maya — great to connect today, and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from our side):
- Demo covered routing policies, fallback variants, and cost controls — we confirmed compatibility with your integration goals.
- Red flags to flag early: anything requiring customer-owned IdP cert rotation cadence or custom SCIM attributes can add ~1-2 weeks to onboarding.

What we will provide (ETA & format):
- SOC 2: we are currently completing SOC 2 Type II; expected completion date: 2028-08-15. We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report draft under NDA or a SOC 2 readiness attestation this week. (ETA: 3 business days for attestation; final report in August)
- SSO/SAML: SP metadata (XML), recommended AssertionConsumerService URL, sample IdP metadata mapping, and a short configuration checklist. (ETA: 2 business days)
- SCIM provisioning: documentation describing supported endpoints, attribute mapping, and a 7-day sample provisioning log export (redacted). (ETA: 4 business days)
- RBAC & admin controls: roles matrix + who can request role changes and audit log excerpt showing admin role changes. (ETA: 3 business days)
- HIPAA/GDPR: we have a standard DPA; for HIPAA/BAA we can provide our standard BAA template and discuss any carve-outs. (ETA: 5 business days for draft)

Immediate asks for your team:
1) If possible, return the completed questionnaire (attached) or mark high-priority rows so we can triage artifacts.
2) Share the SP metadata or example IdP you intend to use (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) so we can validate attribute mappings in advance.
3) Confirm procurement timeline and any specific evidence requirements (e.g., notarized SOC reports).

I’m attaching a one-page IdAM evidence checklist to help triage what to send first. I’ll loop in our security lead Prioym (cc’d) to help with any deep technical evidence requests. Laura is on copy for onboarding and timelines. Happy to schedule a short (30m) intake call Wednesday or Thursday next week.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
